nom: IT Cosmetics Confidence in an Eye Cream Anti-Aging Peptide Eye Cream

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including under the eyes, describe the cream as rich and hydrating, with several reporting reduced fine lines, though one reports the product dries out the skin around the eyes during the day.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say this is the rare eye cream that never irritates, waters, or reddens their eyes even with allergies or eczema, while others report burning, itching, redness, or swelling that made them stop use.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention being older (40s, 50s, 70s, 85) report visibly reduced fine lines, firmer and brighter under-eye skin, and easy application on fragile skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found the sampler moisturizing with a creamy texture and no added greasiness.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles, firmer and smoother under-eye skin, and some noting improvement within weeks; a few say they saw no firming or wrinkle change after months of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as very hydrating and moisturizing with lasting comfort; a minority report the opposite, saying it dries out the eye area or that hydration does not last through the day.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report their eyes becoming red, swollen, or inflamed after application, sometimes appearing within hours or after the first night, though others with sensitive skin specifically report no redness.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe burning, stinging, or an itching/burning sensation on application, with one noting it happened consistently on repeat use; one long-term user says it lets her tolerate retinol without chafing or itch.
concerns.spots: One reviewer notes it does not cause breakouts despite regular use; no other spot-specific reports appear.
concerns.blemishes: Not enough reviewer comments specifically on blemishes beyond the no-breakout mention above.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers describe the formula as non-greasy and lightweight, including one with oily skin who found it moisturizing without added oil.

aspects.libelle: Small amount goes a long way
Unscented or subtle scent reassures allergy-prone users
High price relative to results for some

extraits.titre: Sensitive Eyes? Puffy Eyes? Sick of hunting?  TRY THIS!
extraits.texte: While I buy A LOT of skin care and makeup, I don't typically write many reviews. This product must be shared though. I have struggled finding an eye cream that actually works and is good for my sensitive eyelids. I have tried them all. Super expensive to drug store with zero luck. I would wake up in the morning with my eyelids red and nearly touching my eyebrows they were so swollen (it's not a good look BTW....). If I found something that didn't irritate my eyes, it also did nothing. Nada. Zip. This is IT (pun intended). Seriously, one application and overnight my eyes went from hooded to "hello", red to calm and super moisturized. ONE APPLICATION. 10 out of 10. I honestly cannot gush about this product enough. I will forever have this eye cream in my cabinet.

I have been using Dr Dennis gross products for a long time and his under eye products weren't helping enough with the dryness. I heard good things about confidence and thought I'd try it. My first application felt sooo luxurious. It was everything I was hoping for. Then about 10 minutes later my eyes were burning so bad I couldn't wash my eyes fast enough. I thought maybe I put too much on. So next night I tried again and same thing happened. I cannot use this. I don't understand especially when it says it's formulated with the help of a dermatologist. Doesn't make any sense. I don't have particularly sensitive skin. I'm very bummed that I paid so much and I can't use it. I gave 3 stars because it really does feel luxurious. Disappointed nonetheless.

extraits.titre: Mos Hydrating Eye cream I've Tried
extraits.texte: I tend to have dry skin, including under my eyes, and therefore stated seeing fine lines. This is the only eye cream that is rich enough to hydrate, yet even when I use it in the morning it doesn't cause any of my makeup to bot or smudge. My IT concealer blends beautifully over it. My fine lines are greatly diminished

This eye cream is so moisturizing and I love that I can use it on the upper lid as well as underneath the eye. The skin around my eyes is very sensitive plus I've a ton of allergies and I've never had ANY problems with it and have been using it since it was first introduced years ago. My 72 year old eyes look great and I've recommended it to lots of women and given it as gifts to close friends.
This cream dries out the skin around my eyes during the day causing a dry layer around the eyes which is not pretty. I do not feel any benefit in using this cream. I would not go back to buy again.
I'm new to buying eye creams and they can get pretty pricey. I had just a sampler version, I really enjoyed it. I have oily skin but it moisturized nicely and had creamy texture.

I've been using this eye cream for at least 3 months now, & I haven't noticed any improvements. I have dark circles under my eyes that I thought would lighten some, but sadly they have not. I wouldn't necessarily say the skin feels any firmer/tighter either. I don't have any eye wrinkles so I can't speak on whether it helps with that. For the price, I expected much better results.
